cc:Work.dc:description:
StorageRack to store boxes and trays which have their own floor
Drawers are not included:
![Inside](static/samples/StorageRack-2.jpg) ![Back wall details](static/samples/StorageRack-3.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StorageRack --x 110 --depth 220 --sh 45:55 --rail 35 --outside 1 --bottom_edge F --top_edge 'Š' --labels 1 --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes StorageRack --x --depth --sh --rail --bottom_edge --top_edge --reference
